title: THE LAMP ROOM - WINTER PRINT SERIES

sections.heading: About the series
sections.body:
Eight original linocuts by the Lamp Room collective.
Each print is pulled by hand from maple blocks
and signed in pencil in an edition of forty.
Subscribers receive a proof before release.

sections.heading: Dates
sections.body:
Exhibition opens Friday 3 November at 18:00.
Evening hours run through December.

sections.heading: How to visit
sections.body:
Entry is free and no booking is required.
The press room is open to visitors on Mondays.

layout.footer_text: Set and proofed at the Lamp Room press, 2024
